programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Split is terrified of sliding down the necks of giant Broccolisaurus.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: On a picnic in the park, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands. But when Coco keeps taking shortcuts, Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a Scrufflelump in the woods, and despite Duggee’s reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk through a farm to a pumpkin patch. On the way, they find a hidden den in the forest, make goat noises, have fun with binoculars and even trot like ponies!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family head to the harbour and have fun trying to catch crabs. Will the crustacean critters be tempted by the bacon bait? Back home, Ted helps Dad clean Mum’s car, and then they make delicious spaghetti and meatballs for the whole family.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Ameliya's family come from a country called Trinidad and Tobago, and today she is cooking a popular Trinidadian dish: pepper roti. Ameliya rolls out her dough into big circles before adding a very colourful filling of carrot, red pepper, cheese and her special ingredient, spinach. The roti are then rolled up into a cone, flattened and rolled out again before being cooked. Ameliya has a very special Trinidadian surprise for her friends while they eat, but will they enjoy her tasty spinach?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is relaxing at home, playing games and watching television. She shows us how a television screen works using millions of tiny squares called pixels. Using her special microscope camera, Maddie shows us how a pixel can make any colour from just three coloured lights - red, blue and green. Next she visits a factory where carpet is made. Maddie follows the journey that wool takes, from shearing a sheep to going through the factory, to end up in the carpets we have at home. Maddie uses her special slow-motion camera to show us how the different coloured threads are woven together on a loom to make a carpet.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog with big soft cuddles who loves to help people when they’re worried. She and her owner Katrina visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. Sylvie and her owner Katrina are helping a girl called Akilah, who is joining the local school after arriving from a foreign country. Lots of things will be very different for her, so Sylvie will need her super heart to make her feel as welcome as possible. After meeting Akilah and her mum, along with Fred the teaching assistant, Sylvie takes her to the school hall for some lunch, stopping to admire some artwork along the way. Then Sylvie acts as Akilah’s furry tour guide on a whistlestop tour of the school, including a trip to the library, before guiding her to her new classroom to meet the teacher and all her new friends. There will be lots of new faces, and everyone will be talking in a language she’s still learning - but with Sylvie and her super heart by her side, Akilah is sure to make lots of friends.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some colourful characters – peacocks. These birds have vibrant blue and green trains of feathers that can grow 1.5 metres long, which is taller than Aneeshwar! Next, they head out to feed the gorillas their breakfast. The pair have fun using tennis ball throwers to deliver fruit and vegetables to these remarkable animals. They see a huge male silverback, as well as young babies clinging to their mothers' arms. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: When Jess takes Evie for her first school visit, Waffle goes along too - on the condition that he doesn't sing. He tries his best to behave, but it's hard for a Wonder Dog! On their walk to school, Jess and Evie bump into Connie Lester and her daughter Ruby. Ruby reveals that she will also be starting at Sommersby School too, in the year above Evie. Ruby enjoys stroking Waffle and tells Evie that she loves animals. She has a pet dog of her own, Jelly, a yellow labrador. Waffle introduces himself to Jelly, but decides Jelly is a grumpy dog. Meanwhile, there's a For Sale sign in Mrs Hobbs' front garden. Mrs Hobbs and George are moving house and leaving Maple Close forever.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona misses out on fun with her friends, but Baba finds a way to cheer her up.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. The Small Potatoes sing a punk rock anthem about how wonderful it is to just be yourself.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When a bee interrupts the gang’s sunflower-growing contest, the results are unexpectedly musical!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: There's a new addition to the household with the arrival of Bruce the goldfish. On the face of it, he can't do tricks, he just blows bubbles and goes bloop. Maddie and Triggs begin to realise that all the great things they love to do are together. Maybe a friend in the tank is what Bruce needs for inspiration?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It is a rainy day in the clubhouse, which means it’s a perfect day for a board game. Duggee introduces the Squirrels to one of his favourite games, but it might be just a little bit too complex for them.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: A little block falls out of the sky, meets her numberling and discovers one wonderful world, singing and counting to one. Learn all about the number 1 with Numberblock One!

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Alphablocks A and M take a parcel to Alphablocks T, P and S - the Trusty Postal Service. They try to make a postage STAMP for it. A large boot stamps the parcel flat! Alphablock S has to reinflate it. They try the STAMP again - success! Next, Alphablock I wants T, P and S to deliver an elephant to its home. But how? It is very heavy. They try to make it SPRINT, but it runs amok. It won’t SPRING home, either. They make Alphablock P STRONG so that she can carry the elephant all the way home on her own.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends enjoy a day exploring the forest, whilst Mr Tumble goes on a nature hunt with Tumble Ted.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The voice trumpet leads a game of I Spy where the Teletubbies have to spot different colours - purple, green, yellow and red. What or who can they spot with those colours?

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how soil plays an important role in the environment. They find out that plants, trees and food crops all grow in soil, using the nutrients and water in it to grow. They learn that lots of creatures live in the soil too, and some animals even dig their homes into the soil for shelter. On the way, they spot a badger’s sett and do an amazing soil experiment!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team’s new coach but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs - with chaotic results.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: A Very Important Pup visits Pup School for the grand opening of the school's brand new bug hotel. It's Dodge's special job to show the VIP around the school, but things don't go to plan. Dodge feels like he has let everyone down and thinks the VIP won't want to stay to open the new hotel... but things turn out very differently.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster is directing a play called The Mystery Package, but he can’t decide if Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny or Bad Idea Puppy should get the starring role of the package presenter.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter discovers Mr Tod is the host of a surprise party, he must save the guests from becoming party food.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels make their very own perfumes with accompanying advertisements to show how their perfumes are uniquely theirs.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Zigzag hasn’t had a poo in two days and doesn’t want to go on the scavenger hunt with her friends. Vida sets up a scavenger hunt just for her in the clinic, which is full of clues to help her go.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea freezes the Veggies so she can take over the whole supermarket. Chilli’s heat unfreezes Supertato, who then races on lolly-stick skis to thwart Evil Pea and save the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings and Weasy battle for the last piece of popcorn, but it ends up getting thrown out the window. The Weasy family will have to go without a treat - unless they can find a way to get the farmer's packet!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Tao can’t go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo’s tops!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Grandad plays restaurant with the kids but struggles to order food on their app.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Nugget’s favourite teddy bear gets accidentally washed by Pancake, the Piripenguins try to restore its unique smell by painstakingly recreating Nugget’s happiest memories.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Ava’s solar gadgets malfunction, making her doubt her skills. But with PC Plum’s encouragement, she realises that each invention needs a different-sized solar panel.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: The Brooklyn-Bells are looking after the kitten from Jess's veterinary practice. When Waffle checks on the kitten, it's not in its bed. In fact, the kitten is nowhere to be seen. The Brooklyn-Bells don't see it disappear into the utility cupboard and through the tunnel to Mrs Hobbs's house next door. When Mrs Hobbs meets the kitten, she mistakes it for her beloved cat George. She falls in love with the kitten and doesn't want it to leave.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: It’s a busy day at the Bake A Wish Café. Rafi wants to bake with Jake in the kitchen and help Dash at the Wizard Wagon in the park. She wishes to be in two places at once, and a magical portal lets her hop between them! It’s exciting at first, but things soon become muddled. Rafi grows tired and realises it’s too hard to do everything at once. With her dads’ support, she realises it’s sometimes better to focus on one thing at a time.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo is determined to slide down the big slide at the park. But even though it’s sunny when they leave the house, a rainy weather forecast threatens her plans. Luckily for her, Gran Gran has come prepared!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck make a colourful new friend during breakfast.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Major is busy in his workshop and three froglets are helping. When he’s finished, Major is so pleased he gives each froglet a medal to thank them for their help. When the other froglets see the medals they all want one. But Major has no more work to do, and there are no more medals. The medal wearing froglets now see themselves as better than the other froglets, and soon the two groups are not talking to each other. It takes all of Major’s and Granny’s cunning to settle this froglet dispute.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: BaBa is giggling and gets the hiccups, hiccuping all the way to the Play Tree. MeMo winds the handle of a music box until up pops a jack-in-the-box. This big surprise doesn’t shock the hiccups away. The Yummies ask BaBa and MeMo to help them wash some fruit. It’s a mindful moment, and BaBa forgets about the hiccups. MeMo helps BaBa relax on the Lullaby Lake, and the hiccups disappear.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. The Tombliboos and Makka Pakka take a ride on the Ninky Nonk. The Tombliboos' trousers fly off and whiz around the Ninky Nonk. The Tombliboos forget their trousers, leaving them on the Ninky Nonk, and have to go home without them. Then, Makka Pakka arrives with a present for the Tombliboos.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: All aboard the Night-Time Train with Justin Fletcher for a sleepy bedtime ride.

programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s the bouncing and singing Cranberries, who sweep everyone off their feet.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing is playing in the garden when he sees his shadow. Flop has one too. Flop and Bing play shadow tag, taking it in turns to be 'it'. But just as Bing is about to have a turn, a raincloud covers the sun and the shadows disappear. Flop persuades Bing to go inside, out of the rain, but Bing is upset that his shadow is getting wet in the garden. With the aid of a torch, Flop shows Bing that shadows never go far from their owners.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po want to go outside, but it's raining. Some wellies and umbrellas magically appear and the Teletubbies go outside for splashy, rainy fun.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Preschool animation about a baby monkey and his mother. After finding his old baby bonnet under the sofa, Tee and Mo remember what it was like when Tee was still a baby.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea causes chaos in the veggie aisle with a trolley loaded to the brim with stinky cheese. Supertato and Broccoli must use the Tato Car to get rid of the stink.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and his friends are making leaf pictures in the woods. They take a piece of paper, place it on a leaf and rub a crayon onto it. They each choose their own leaf, but Bing's is whisked away by the wind! Luckily, he manages to catch it by stamping on it. When the wind also whisks Coco's picture off the table, Bing tries to catch it but once again ends up stamping on it. Now Coco is angry!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: An old map, mysterious clues and ancient secrets... Mojo and Bo are after the treasure of the Knights of Swoppiton! But Preston’s after it too, so they need to get there first.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: There is another mysterious case to solve, with the help of Detective Puppy. Buggee and Chippo are at the mercy of a spinning block, and the Squirrels enjoy tidying up while listening to music.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn’t always enjoy playing. Since her first day at Squirrel Club, she always impressed everyone with her confidence and independence, but at first she didn’t know how to join in with the others. Luckily, Duggee had a great idea to bring all the Squirrels together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Grandad plays restaurant with the kids but struggles to order food on their app.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.desc: Glitch makes a sandcastle around an oasis in the Sahara. Can the Go Jetters save the day?

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter decides to set Mr Tod and Tommy Brock against each other, he soon finds out that breaking the food chain is harder than it looks.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. When Peso's little brother Pinto comes to visit, he is more interested in being a pirate than a medic, at least until he accompanies Peso on a mission to rescue Dashi and Shellington in a kelp forest.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: All aboard for a riotous railway ride as the Numberblocks try to stop a runaway train. Learn all the number bonds up to five with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: O goes through the magnifying glass to where the grass is blue, the trees are square and nonsense words make friendly monsters who run off with magnifying glasses! This episode has fun with O and nonsense words, the word odd and the non-words og, yog, zog, zox and vox.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick is helping in the charity store, which is full of amazing things. The Popcasters donate more amazing things and write today’s song. Norman gets a surprise when Nick returns home with a special gift.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella shows off her favourite apron with lots of pockets, each holding a surprise for Lift to enjoy. Lift has an idea to explore the floors of Playtime Towers, and their first stop is the Fortress of Fun. Here, Kingsley and Queenie play a fun game called ‘the Royal Egg Race’, but who will win, Team King or Team Queen? In the Ice Disco, Hettie the Yeti plays with some maracas - they are perfect for a shaky dance with the Playtimers. In the Cloud Kitchen, Patch finds a tiny mouse in his pocket, which reminds him of a tasty recipe - pocket mouse pitta!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Flop are making ginger bunny biscuits for Charlie and Coco. But when Charlie and Coco arrive, Charlie's done a mega poo, and in all the fuss cleaning him up, nobody hears the chickie timer ring to tell them that the biscuits are cooked.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘orange’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see an orange orange, some slices, a tasty one and meet a juicy orange! There’s an orange winning a football match and one spinning all around. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: The bugs decorate rocks.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The Piggies are struggling with a tricky game. When Fiona asks for help tidying her garden, they bring the toy along - but they get distracted and make an even bigger mess. Can they play and work at the same time?

programme.desc: The Squirrels make their very own perfumes with accompanying advertisements to show how their perfumes are uniquely theirs.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Zigzag hasn’t had a poo in two days and doesn’t want to go on the scavenger hunt with her friends. Vida sets up a scavenger hunt just for her in the clinic, which is full of clues to help her go.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea freezes the Veggies so she can take over the whole supermarket. Chilli’s heat unfreezes Supertato, who then races on lolly-stick skis to thwart Evil Pea and save the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings and Weasy battle for the last piece of popcorn, but it ends up getting thrown out the window. The Weasy family will have to go without a treat - unless they can find a way to get the farmer's packet!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Tao can’t go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo’s tops!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Grandad plays restaurant with the kids but struggles to order food on their app.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Nugget’s favourite teddy bear gets accidentally washed by Pancake, the Piripenguins try to restore its unique smell by painstakingly recreating Nugget’s happiest memories.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey, Snickers and Winton are ambushed by the Terriers on the way to see Calypso.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Ava’s solar gadgets malfunction, making her doubt her skills. But with PC Plum’s encouragement, she realises that each invention needs a different-sized solar panel.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: The Brooklyn-Bells are looking after the kitten from Jess's veterinary practice. When Waffle checks on the kitten, it's not in its bed. In fact, the kitten is nowhere to be seen. The Brooklyn-Bells don't see it disappear into the utility cupboard and through the tunnel to Mrs Hobbs's house next door. When Mrs Hobbs meets the kitten, she mistakes it for her beloved cat George. She falls in love with the kitten and doesn't want it to leave.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: It’s a busy day at the Bake A Wish Café. Rafi wants to bake with Jake in the kitchen and help Dash at the Wizard Wagon in the park. She wishes to be in two places at once, and a magical portal lets her hop between them! It’s exciting at first, but things soon become muddled. Rafi grows tired and realises it’s too hard to do everything at once. With her dads’ support, she realises it’s sometimes better to focus on one thing at a time.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo is determined to slide down the big slide at the park. But even though it’s sunny when they leave the house, a rainy weather forecast threatens her plans. Luckily for her, Gran Gran has come prepared!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck make a colourful new friend during breakfast.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Major is busy in his workshop and three froglets are helping. When he’s finished, Major is so pleased he gives each froglet a medal to thank them for their help. When the other froglets see the medals they all want one. But Major has no more work to do, and there are no more medals. The medal wearing froglets now see themselves as better than the other froglets, and soon the two groups are not talking to each other. It takes all of Major’s and Granny’s cunning to settle this froglet dispute.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: BaBa is giggling and gets the hiccups, hiccuping all the way to the Play Tree. MeMo winds the handle of a music box until up pops a jack-in-the-box. This big surprise doesn’t shock the hiccups away. The Yummies ask BaBa and MeMo to help them wash some fruit. It’s a mindful moment, and BaBa forgets about the hiccups. MeMo helps BaBa relax on the Lullaby Lake, and the hiccups disappear.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. The Tombliboos and Makka Pakka take a ride on the Ninky Nonk. The Tombliboos' trousers fly off and whiz around the Ninky Nonk. The Tombliboos forget their trousers, leaving them on the Ninky Nonk, and have to go home without them. Then, Makka Pakka arrives with a present for the Tombliboos.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In our first case this episode, a 66-year-old mum looks for the baby she gave up as a teenager in a search given greater urgency by her cancer diagnosis. A mother for the first time when she was a Blackpool teenager, Charlotte has always yearned for the baby she had to give up for adoption - recently diagnosed and now recovering from cancer, Charlotte feels that this is her second chance and that the search for her daughter is urgent. In our second story, a woman who was donor-conceived seeks answers to many questions including if she has any siblings out there. Most people who approach Long Lost Family for help are looking for a specific family member - a parent who gave them up for adoption or a sibling they learnt about from their records - but Jenna's experience is completely different as she was conceived with the help of a sperm donor and so has got absolutely no idea what or who she might find.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Two households come under fire at the third removal, and another realises they must go against their friendships and vote tactically to make it further in the competition. Following the tense removal, Graham hosts a cocktail party for the neighbours to relax. Unbeknownst to them, this event serves to secretly introduce a new family, allowing them to spy on the existing residents before their official introduction. This is the final arrival, as the Neighbourhood gates are now closed and neighbours will only be leaving from now on. Graham makes a night-time visit to bestow the title of 'The Secret Power House' upon one lucky household via a game of chance. The winners are granted the power to sway the course of the game and favour their own house. However, all of their choices will be disclosed at the end of the week, raising the question: how will they choose to wield this newfound power?

programme.desc: In our first case this episode, a 66-year-old mum looks for the baby she gave up as a teenager in a search given greater urgency by her cancer diagnosis. A mother for the first time when she was a Blackpool teenager, Charlotte has always yearned for the baby she had to give up for adoption - recently diagnosed and now recovering from cancer, Charlotte feels that this is her second chance and that the search for her daughter is urgent. programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In our first case this episode, a 66-year-old mum looks for the baby she gave up as a teenager in a search given greater urgency by her cancer diagnosis. A mother for the first time when she was a Blackpool teenager, Charlotte has always yearned for the baby she had to give up for adoption - recently diagnosed and now recovering from cancer, Charlotte feels that this is her second chance and that the search for her daughter is urgent. In our second story, a woman who was donor-conceived seeks answers to many questions including if she has any siblings out there. Most people who approach Long Lost Family for help are looking for a specific family member - a parent who gave them up for adoption or a sibling they learnt about from their records - but Jenna's experience is completely different as she was conceived with the help of a sperm donor and so has got absolutely no idea what or who she might find.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Two households come under fire at the third removal, and another realises they must go against their friendships and vote tactically to make it further in the competition. Following the tense removal, Graham hosts a cocktail party for the neighbours to relax. Unbeknownst to them, this event serves to secretly introduce a new family, allowing them to spy on the existing residents before their official introduction. This is the final arrival, as the Neighbourhood gates are now closed and neighbours will only be leaving from now on. Graham makes a night-time visit to bestow the title of 'The Secret Power House' upon one lucky household via a game of chance. The winners are granted the power to sway the course of the game and favour their own house. However, all of their choices will be disclosed at the end of the week, raising the question: how will they choose to wield this newfound power?

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Two households come under fire at the third removal, and another realises they must go against their friendships and vote tactically to make it further in the competition. Following the tense removal, Graham hosts a cocktail party for the neighbours to relax. Unbeknownst to them, this event serves to secretly introduce a new family, allowing them to spy on the existing residents before their official introduction. This is the final arrival, as the Neighbourhood gates are now closed and neighbours will only be leaving from now on. Graham makes a night-time visit to bestow the title of 'The Secret Power House' upon one lucky household via a game of chance. The winners are granted the power to sway the course of the game and favour their own house. However, all of their choices will be disclosed at the end of the week, raising the question: how will they choose to wield this newfound power?

Now back in his original surroundings, Bruce adopts the image of a bat to strike fear into Gotham City's criminals and corrupt lowlifes...

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In our first case this episode, a 66-year-old mum looks for the baby she gave up as a teenager in a search given greater urgency by her cancer diagnosis. A mother for the first time when she was a Blackpool teenager, Charlotte has always yearned for the baby she had to give up for adoption - recently diagnosed and now recovering from cancer, Charlotte feels that this is her second chance and that the search for her daughter is urgent. In our second story, a woman who was donor-conceived seeks answers to many questions including if she has any siblings out there. Most people who approach Long Lost Family for help are looking for a specific family member - a parent who gave them up for adoption or a sibling they learnt about from their records - but Jenna's experience is completely different as she was conceived with the help of a sperm donor and so has got absolutely no idea what or who she might find.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Two households come under fire at the third removal, and another realises they must go against their friendships and vote tactically to make it further in the competition. Following the tense removal, Graham hosts a cocktail party for the neighbours to relax. Unbeknownst to them, this event serves to secretly introduce a new family, allowing them to spy on the existing residents before their official introduction. This is the final arrival, as the Neighbourhood gates are now closed and neighbours will only be leaving from now on. Graham makes a night-time visit to bestow the title of 'The Secret Power House' upon one lucky household via a game of chance. The winners are granted the power to sway the course of the game and favour their own house. However, all of their choices will be disclosed at the end of the week, raising the question: how will they choose to wield this newfound power?

programme.desc: In our first case this episode, a 66-year-old mum looks for the baby she gave up as a teenager in a search given greater urgency by her cancer diagnosis. In our second story, a woman who was donor-conceived seeks answers to many questions including if she has any siblings out there. Most people who approach Long Lost Family for help are looking for a specific family member - a parent who gave them up for adoption or a sibling they learnt about from their records - but Jenna's experience is completely different as she was conceived with the help of a sperm donor and so has got absolutely no idea what or who she might find.

programme.title: Olivia & Alex: Parenthood
programme.desc: Olivia and Alex Bowen are back with more family chaos and their trademark mix of love, laughter and parenthood challenges - from chaotic doula sessions to DIY disagreements and birth plan bickering, the couple prove that they really know how to argue and how to make up. Amidst Olivia's dramatic spirals and Alex's earnest attempts to 'just make a list' that turn everyday stresses into comedy gold, Alex bonds with Olivia's dad over golf away from home while Olivia discusses Alex with his mum Louise and then heads out to enjoy some girl talk with Love Island bestie Tina Stinnes - as the couple prepare their home for their new baby girl, Alex and Olivia's humour shines through and shows that the beauty of parenthood is in its chaos.

programme.desc: US reality series following the lavish lifestyle of New Jersey housewives and their families. programme.title: Ant & Dec's Limitless Win
programme.desc: Ant and Dec return to help more contestants climb as high up the never-ending money ladder as they can - husband-and-wife team Paul and Ellie are back to continue their journey up the Limitless Ladder this time as they want to win enough money to buy a swanky new RV and take the ultimate trip of a lifetime around Europe. The duo then welcome father and daughter Denis and Becca to the studio - their approach is 'go big or go home', but they're going to get the surprise of their lives as they try to win as much of the life-changing sums of money on offer as they can.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: The American version of Gordon Ramsay's culinary boot camp. programme.desc: Anarchic animated sitcom about a dysfunctional family in a wacky Rhode Island town. programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: In our first case this episode, a 66-year-old mum looks for the baby she gave up as a teenager in a search given greater urgency by her cancer diagnosis. A mother for the first time when she was a Blackpool teenager, Charlotte has always yearned for the baby she had to give up for adoption - recently diagnosed and now recovering from cancer, Charlotte feels that this is her second chance and that the search for her daughter is urgent. In our second story, a woman who was donor-conceived seeks answers to many questions including if she has any siblings out there. Most people who approach Long Lost Family for help are looking for a specific family member - a parent who gave them up for adoption or a sibling they learnt about from their records - but Jenna's experience is completely different as she was conceived with the help of a sperm donor and so has got absolutely no idea what or who she might find.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Two households come under fire at the third removal, and another realises they must go against their friendships and vote tactically to make it further in the competition. Following the tense removal, Graham hosts a cocktail party for the neighbours to relax. Unbeknownst to them, this event serves to secretly introduce a new family, allowing them to spy on the existing residents before their official introduction. This is the final arrival, as the Neighbourhood gates are now closed and neighbours will only be leaving from now on. Graham makes a night-time visit to bestow the title of 'The Secret Power House' upon one lucky household via a game of chance. The winners are granted the power to sway the course of the game and favour their own house. However, all of their choices will be disclosed at the end of the week, raising the question: how will they choose to wield this newfound power?

programme.title: Batman Begins
programme.desc: Action crime drama reboot of the Batman film franchise. When his parents are killed, billionaire playboy Bruce Wayne relocates to Asia and is given lessons on how to fight evil - having learnt about an evil plan of villains Henri Ducard and Ra's al Ghul to destroy his home city of Gotham, Bruce prevents this plan from getting any further and heads back home. Now back in his original surroundings, Bruce adopts the image of a bat to strike fear into Gotham City's criminals and corrupt lowlifes...

In our second story, a woman who was donor-conceived seeks answers to many questions including if she has any siblings out there. Most people who approach Long Lost Family for help are looking for a specific family member - a parent who gave them up for adoption or a sibling they learnt about from their records - but Jenna's experience is completely different as she was conceived with the help of a sperm donor and so has got absolutely no idea what or who she might find.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Two households come under fire at the third removal, and another realises they must go against their friendships and vote tactically to make it further in the competition. Following the tense removal, Graham hosts a cocktail party for the neighbours to relax. Unbeknownst to them, this event serves to secretly introduce a new family, allowing them to spy on the existing residents before their official introduction. This is the final arrival, as the Neighbourhood gates are now closed and neighbours will only be leaving from now on. Graham makes a night-time visit to bestow the title of 'The Secret Power House' upon one lucky household via a game of chance. The winners are granted the power to sway the course of the game and favour their own house. However, all of their choices will be disclosed at the end of the week, raising the question: how will they choose to wield this newfound power?
